title: Choose a path
description: Make the story respond to a choice.

tasks.title: Give your story two possible paths
tasks.body: An if statement runs an indented block only when its condition is true. == compares two values. An else block runs when that condition is false.
tasks.detail: Use a colon after the if condition and after else. Indent the instructions inside each block by four spaces. Our example compares exact lowercase text: left. Any other reply takes the else path.

tasks.note: With left as the reply, only the waterfall line runs. With right, only the library line runs.

tasks.question: Which block runs when path is "right"?
tasks.why: "right" == "left" is false, so Python skips the if block and runs the else block.

tasks.prompt: Give both paths new discoveries. Run with left, then with right. Confirm that the discoveries differ.
Ask the player to choose left or right. Use if and else to print a different nonempty discovery for each choice. Keep the replies as lowercase left and right; invent your own discoveries.
tasks.starter:
path = input("Left or right? ")
if path == "left":
    # Print one discovery
    pass
else:
    # Print a different discovery
    pass
hints: Compare path with "left" using two equals signs: ==.
Both if and else need a colon. Their print statements need indentation.
Replace each pass with print("your discovery"). Make the two discoveries different.
